---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new function, script, or enhancement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What are you trying to accomplish that isn't currently covered? Prefer
describing the underlying problem over a specific implementation.

## Proposed solution

What should this look like — a new function, a new parameter on an existing
one, a new report field, etc.?

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you considered, including existing functions that come
close but don't quite fit.

## Scope

- [ ] Read-only (inventory/report/audit)
- [ ] Makes changes to AD/DCs/scheduled tasks (state whether `-WhatIf` support is expected)
- [ ] Requires a new dependency (module, protocol, port) — note it here

## Additional context

Anything else useful — AD topology this needs to handle, scale considerations,
related issues.
